rationale: The pain is real and well-documented — indie devs and solo operators running their own mail servers get silently blacklisted by Outlook/Gmail with no appeal path, and the poster explicitly states willingness to pay $5–30/month for a managed alternative. The buyer is a nameable technical persona (indie dev / small-biz sysadmin) with a clear software-buying history. However, the deciding factor holding this at validate is operational_autonomy: a deliverability health-check or warm-IP relay requires ongoing IP reputation management, ISP relationship handling, and potentially per-customer SMTP relay infrastructure — none of which is hands-off for a solo operator with Claude tooling. The build_gate for operational_autonomy (floor: 7) is unmet at 5, and buildability_with_ai is also below floor at 5.
solution_plan: The micro-service is a self-hosted email deliverability audit and monitoring report — a weekly automated check of a customer's domain/IP against major blacklists (Spamhaus, Barracuda, Microsoft SNDS), SPF/DKIM/DMARC validity, and inbox placement test results, delivered as a clean PDF/HTML report by email. BUILD: the factory sets up a Claude-driven pipeline that calls public blacklist APIs and MX toolbox-style checks, formats results into a readable report, and emails it via an existing transactional provider (Postmark or Resend); a simple landing page with Stripe at $15–25/month handles signup — no operator coding needed. SELL: reach technical founders via HN 'Show HN', indie hacker communities (Indie Hackers, /r/selfhosted), and cold outreach to operators posting in self-hosting Discord/Reddit threads; outreach batches go out only after operator approval. MAINTAIN: billing via Stripe, report generation and delivery fully automated by Claude + cron; operator's only recurring touch is approving outreach batches and monitoring for API failures. CAVEAT: this is an audit/advisory service, NOT a managed relay — building an actual warm-IP relay would require physical infrastructure Youval cannot run hands-off, so scope must stay at monitoring/reporting only.
notes: Build gates failing: operational_autonomy=5 (floor 7), buildability_with_ai=5 (floor 6). Stage capped at validate. If scoped strictly to audit/monitoring reports (not relay infrastructure), buildability improves to ~7 but autonomy remains borderline — recommend validating that buyers will pay for monitoring-only before committing to build.
